Probably Bad Boys because Im familiar with the previous films so I know what to expect. Bloodshot might just be a nice surprise though.

I like suspenseful thrillers with a good plot twist. Something that keeps me on the edge of my seat but also makes me think.
I have a good feeling about this! I'd like to recommend "The One I Love" (2014).
The One I Love sounds intriguing. Can you tell me more about it?

The One I Love is a romantic comedy-thriller film that follows a couple who discover a way to access alternate versions of themselves. It's a unique take on the traditional romantic comedy and has a great plot twist at the end. It's a fun and engaging film that will keep you guessing until the very end.
That does sound interesting. I like the idea of a twisty plot. Can you tell me if it's more on the suspense side or more comedic?
I would say it's more on the romantic comedy side with a thriller twist. It has a good balance of humor and suspense.
I see. I think I'll go with this one. Thanks for the recommendation!

You're welcome! I hope you enjoy The One I Love. Have a great day!
